title: Fatigue-Detector-Rehab: an adaptive fatigue detection model for virtual reality-based physical therapy
description: Machine learning model that estimates the level of fatigue (low, moderate, high and very high) during the Box and Block exercise in the Rehab-Immersive system, together with utilities for exercise data analysis and report generation. This work was supported by the Spanish Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities / Agencia Estatal de Investigación under grant PID2020-117361RB-C21 (project REHAB-IMMERSIVE), and carried out by the AIR Research Group of the Universidad de Castilla-La Mancha in collaboration with the Hospital Nacional de Parapléjicos (Toledo, Spain).
